items.teaser: Three Ukrainian universities in Uman, Kremenchuk, and Kyiv were damaged in a Russian attack overnight.

items.title: Russia releases US prisoner Stephen Hubbard during Witkoff visit
items.teaser: Russian leader Vladimir Putin announced the release of Hubbard during his meeting with U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff.

items.title: Tusk calls Lviv Regional Council’s UPA resolution “suicidal tactics”
items.teaser: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has criticized the Lviv Regional Council’s decision to declare 2027 the Year of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA) and Roman Shukhevych, saying the move harms Ukraine and complicates Polish-Ukrainian cooperation.

items.title: Russland lässt inhaftierten US-Bürger Stephen Hubbard frei
items.teaser: Russland hat den US-Bürger Stephen Hubbard freigelassen. Das bestätigten Präsident Putin und US-Unterhändler Witkoff. Hubbard war 2024 in Moskau wegen angeblichem "Söldnertum" für die Ukraine zu einer Haftstrafe von fast sieben Jahren verurteilt worden.

items.title: Krisen-Vorbereitung ist große Herausforderung für Krankenhäuser
items.teaser: Was müssen Kliniken bedenken, um auch bei Sabotage, Krieg oder Hitze handlungsfähig bleiben zu können? Und was bringt die Vernetzung mit anderen Krankenhäusern?

items.title: Russia releases 74-year-old American prisoner during envoy Witkoff's visit
items.teaser: Stephen Hubbard, an American who had been imprisoned in Russia for more than four years, has been released during US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff's visit to St Petersburg.

items.title: Medienbericht - Interne Lageeinschätzung: Bundeswehr warnt vor russischen Anschlägen auf militärische Einrichtungen
items.teaser: Die Bundeswehr sieht sich durch mögliche russische Sabotageakte bedroht.

items.title: Two nights, two occupied capitals, two telecom operators running on seized Ukrainian assets: drones go after Russia’s communications in Donbas
items.teaser: The strikes on Donetsk and Luhansk hit the companies the occupation built on Ukrainian telecom property it seized.

items.title: Russia frees jailed American Stephen Hubbard, US envoy says
items.teaser: After the meeting, Putin announced the release of Stephen Hubbard, an American taken captive by Russian forces years ago in Ukraine.

items.title: Russia frees jailed American Stephen Hubbard during Witkoff talks
items.teaser: Russian President Vladimir Putin announced the release of Stephen Hubbard, an American taken captive by Russian forces years ago in Ukraine.

items.title: Seven killed in Sloviansk as rescue workers spend five days clearing rubble
items.teaser: Rescue workers have completed emergency operations following Russian airstrikes on Sloviansk, Donetsk region, on October 17, recovering the bodies of seven people from the rubble of two five-story apartment buildings.

items.title: Azov dismisses Russian claim of capturing Dobropillia
items.teaser: The First Corps of Ukraine’s National Guard, Azov, has dismissed Russian claims that Russian forces captured Dobropillia, calling them disinformation.

items.title: Russia is sending first tanker carrying diesel to US
items.teaser: Russia will send its first tanker carrying 40,000 tonnes of diesel fuel to the United States on 22 October, with further shipments expected to follow.

items.title: Angeblich war er Söldner in der Ukraine - Russland meldet Festnahme eines Deutschen
items.teaser: Der FSB wirft einem deutschen Staatsbürger Söldnertum vor; die Angaben sind unbestätigt.

items.title: Putin begins meeting with Trump's envoy Witkoff
items.teaser: Vladimir Putin began talks with Trump envoy Steve Witkoff, who brought settlement proposals and said progress was made in Oslo; economic cooperation was also discussed.

items.title: Ukraine weiterhin unter Russlands Angriff: Energieversorgung, Eisenbahn, Einkaufszentren und Wohnhäuser getroffen
items.teaser: Seit der Nacht vom 21. Oktober führt Russland ununterbrochen Angriffe auf die Energieversorgung, das Eisenbahnnetz, Einkaufszentren und Wohnhäuser in der Ukraine durch.

items.title: Ukraine could receive €17 B in budget support this year, subject to reforms, Costa says
items.teaser: The European Union will play an active role in meeting Ukraine’s financial needs in 2027 and is urging international partners to step up their assistance to maintain pressure on Russia.

items.title: Khmara, Drapatyi discuss stable arms supplies with Lockheed Martin delegation
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara and Commander-in-Chief of the Ukrainian Armed Forces Mykhailo Drapatyi met with a delegation from U.S. defense company Lockheed Martin, led by Orlando Sanchez Jr., President for Aeronautics at Lockheed Martin Corporation, to discuss ensuring stable arms supplies.

items.title: Russian attacks kill at least 9, wound 45 across Ukraine, as yet another deadly drone attack strikes Kyiv
items.teaser: Russian troops launched attacks against Ukraine overnight with Iskander-K cruise missiles and 186 drones, including Shahed-type ones, the Air Force reported.

items.title: One killed and one injured in Russian attacks on Chernihiv
items.teaser: Dmytro Bryzhynskyi has reported that a repeat Russian drone strike killed one person and injured another at a commercial business in Chernihiv.

items.title: Russian drone crashes at Uman National University
items.teaser: Russian forces continued their attacks on the city of Uman in Cherkasy Oblast on the morning of 21 October, striking civilian infrastructure with jet-powered Geran drones.

items.title: 65-Jährige in stabilem Zustand : Australische Politikerin verliert nach Anschlag auch zweites Bein
items.teaser: Am Montag wird die Abgeordnete Helen Haines im australischen Bundesstaat Victoria aus bislang unersichtlichen Gründen von einem Autofahrer angegriffen. Die Ärzte können nun auch ihr rechtes Bein nicht retten. Gegen den Täter wurde inzwischen Anklage erhoben.

items.title: "Wahrscheinlich Zersetzungsabsicht": Bundeswehr warnt vor "erheblicher" Gefahr durch russische Sabotage
items.teaser: Die Bundeswehr warnt laut einem Bericht vor möglichen russischen Sabotageanschlägen auf deutsche Streitkräfte. Dazu verweist sie auf mehrere Drohnenfunde. Ziel sei "politische und gesamtgesellschaftliche Schwächung der deutschen Unterstützung für die Ukraine".

items.title: Russia's destruction of satellites in orbit would also harm its own spacecraft – space law expert
items.teaser: Russia's destruction of satellites in space would not only cause disproportionate harm to other countries but also pose a direct threat to Russian spacecraft themselves. Such actions would also have legal, political and economic consequences for Russia.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 269 Gefechte an der Front: Mehrheit der Angriffe in drei Richtungen
items.teaser: Am 20. Oktober kam es zu 269 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: Russia continues attacks on Ukraine, targeting energy facilities, railways, shopping malls, homes overnight
items.teaser: Russia has been launching continuous strikes on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, railways, shopping malls and residential buildings since last night.

items.title: Rubio calls Zelensky-Witkoff meeting in Norway positive
items.teaser: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio has described as positive the meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump's Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Norway.

items.title: Drones attack telecommunications centre in occupied Luhansk
items.teaser: Drones have attacked a telecommunications centre housing mobile operator Lugacom and technical support facilities in occupied Luhansk.

items.title: Russia strikes Epicentr home improvement superstore in Uman and businesses in four other oblasts
items.teaser: Russian forces struck Ukraine's energy sector, infrastructure facilities and businesses on the night of 20-21 October. The targets included an Epicentr home improvement superstore in Uman and businesses in four oblasts.

items.title: Russen töten vier und verletzen acht Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 20. Oktober töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk vier Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: "Should've lived and created the future of Ukraine": Mariana Tokarchuk, 21, killed in Kyiv attack
items.teaser: Mariana Tokarchuk’s funeral will be held in her home village of Derazhne, her local hromada has announced. She was killed in a Russian missile attack on Kyiv.

items.title: Not just the grid: Russia struck a 24-story block, a university, and warehouses overnight, and four people are dead
items.teaser: Kyiv and Kharkiv Oblast counted the dead by morning, while hypermarkets burned and a hotel was damaged in other regions.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 150 russische Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 150 von 186 Drohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 20. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Man killed in Russian attack in Kyiv region's Bucha district
items.teaser: A man was killed and another person injured in a Russian attack in the Bucha district, Kyiv region.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,570,540 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,820 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Witkoff arrives in St Petersburg for meeting with Putin
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump's special envoy Steve Witkoff has arrived in St Petersburg for talks with Vladimir Putin, with Russia's war against Ukraine expected to be the main topic.

items.title: Rubio: Ukrainians have been doing "extraordinary things", but without US aid, Ukraine would not exist
items.teaser: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has praised the bravery of Ukrainian troops while emphasising that billions in American support have preserved Ukraine's sovereignty.

items.title: Russland: FSB meldet Festnahme eines Deutschen – für Ukraine gekämpft?
items.teaser: Ein Deutscher soll für die Ukraine gekämpft haben. Nun berichten russische Behörden von seiner Festnahme.

items.title: Anti-corruption agency searches Ukraine's central bank chief, source says
items.teaser: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) on Oct. 21 searched the premises of Andriy Pyshnyi, head of the National Bank of Ukraine, a law enforcement source told the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: „Söldnertum“ für Ukraine: Deutscher in Russland festgenommen
items.teaser: Der russische Inlandsgeheimdienst FSB hat laut Medienberichten einen deutschen Staatsbürger wegen des Vorwurfs des „Söldnertums“ für die Ukraine festgenommen.

items.title: Russia attacks enterprise in Chernihiv, one person injured
items.teaser: The Russian army has attacked an enterprise in Chernihiv.

items.title: At least 2 killed, 2 injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv
items.teaser: An air raid alert sounded in Kyiv at around 5:20 a.m. local time on Oct. 21 as drones approached the capital, which has faced an unrelenting barrage of Russian drone attacks this fall.

items.title: European Parliament vice president launches hunger strike demanding a truce and evacuation for Russian-occupied Oleshky
items.teaser: Pina Picierno is calling on associations, citizens, and national and local institutions to join her campaign for the Russian-held town in Ukraine’s Kherson Oblast.

items.title: Axios: Trump's envoy Kushner pressed Ukraine to stop strikes on Russian oil refineries during Oslo talks
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump's son-in-law and special envoy Jared Kushner, who joined the talks in Oslo remotely on 20 October, reiterated Trump's demand that Ukraine stop attacking Russian oil refineries, Axios reports.

items.title: US-Vermittler Witkoff berät mit Putin über Ukraine
items.teaser: Nach Gesprächen mit dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Selenskyj in Oslo ist US-Unterhändler Witkoff zu Verhandlungen mit der russischen Führung in St. Petersburg eingetroffen. US-Präsident Trump hatte Selenskyj zuvor zu einem "Deal" aufgefordert.

items.title: Explosion in Odesa apartment building injures three rescuers, ambulance medic
items.teaser: An explosion involving an unidentified object occurred in a high-rise apartment building in Odesa's Prymorskyi district on the evening of October 20, causing a fire and structural damage. A second explosion occurred during firefighting operations, injuring three rescuers and an ambulance medic.

items.title: Trumps Gesandter Witkoff trifft Putin - News kompakt: Das Wichtigste kurz gefasst
items.teaser: US-Unterhändler Witkoff trifft in St. Petersburg Russlands Präsident Putin um eine neue diplomatische Initiative im Ukraine-Krieg zu starten und Bundeskanzler Merz kündigt nach Gipfeltreffen Schub für Deutschland an.

items.title: News kompakt: Trumps Gesandter Witkoff trifft Putin
items.teaser: US-Unterhändler Witkoff trifft in St. Petersburg Russlands Präsident Putin um eine neue diplomatische Initiative im Ukraine-Krieg zu starten und Bundeskanzler Merz kündigt nach Gipfeltreffen Schub für Deutschland an.

items.title: In Region Cherson 13 Zivilisten, darunter drei Kinder, verletzt, 35 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 35 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurden 13 Zivilisten, darunter drei Kinder, verletzt.

items.title: US envoy Steve Witkoff lands in St. Petersburg for Russia peace talks
items.teaser: Witkoff's movements are taking place while Kyiv's ties with Washington are sharply deteriorating due to concerns that the U.S. could be withholding the delivery of Patriot air-defense missiles funded by Ukraine's allies.

items.title: One killed and one injured in Russian attack on Kyiv Oblast: student accommodation and production building ablaze
items.teaser: Tymur Tkachenko, Head of Kyiv Oblast Military Administration, has reported one dead and one injured after a Russian drone hit Bucha district.

items.title: "Rally-around-the-Flag-Effekt", Vassili Golod, ARD Kiew, zum Gipfel zwischen Trump, Xi und Putin
items.teaser: "Rally-around-the-Flag-Effekt", Vassili Golod, ARD Kiew, zum Gipfel zwischen Trump, Xi und Putin

items.title: US envoy to meet Putin after 'positive' talks with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Steve Witkoff landed in St Petersburg for talks on ending the war in Ukraine. It comes a day after he met with Ukrainian President Volodomyr Zelenskyy in Norway.

items.title: US envoy meets Putin after 'positive' talks with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Steve Witkoff landed in St. Petersburg for talks on ending the war in Ukraine. It comes a day after he met with Ukrainian President Volodomyr Zelenskyy in Norway.

items.title: Ukraine using satellite data to prepare lawsuits in international courts – lawyer
items.teaser: Ukraine is already using satellite data for demining, assessing the impact of the war on the environment, and preparing lawsuits in international courts. In the future, such data could help the country obtain compensation for the damage caused.

items.title: Searches underway at premises linked to Ukrainian National Bank's governor, sources say
items.teaser: Ukraine's National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) and Specialised Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) are conducting searches at premises linked to Andrii Pyshnyi, Governor of the National Bank of Ukraine (NBU).

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1820 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 21. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.570.540 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 1820 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Air defenses intercept 150 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 150 out of the 186 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 20.

items.title: European Parliament Vice President declares hunger strike in support of residents of Oleshky
items.teaser: European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno has called for urgent international action, a humanitarian ceasefire and safe civilian evacuations from Oleshky.

items.title: War update: 269 clashes on front line over past day, Russian forces pressing hardest in three sectors
items.teaser: On October 20, a total of 269 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line.

items.title: WSJ: Elon Musk personally ordered Starlink restrictions for Ukraine
items.teaser: Elon Musk ordered limits on the speed at which Ukrainian military equipment could connect to Starlink, rendering some Ukrainian attack and interceptor drones almost useless, according to The Wall Street Journal.

items.title: Angriff auf Kyjiw: Hochhaus getroffen - es gibt Tote
items.teaser: Bei einem Angriff am Morgen des 21. Oktober auf den Kyjiwer Stadtteil Swjatoschynskyj wurde ein 24-stöckiges Wohnhaus getroffen.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,820 over past day
items.teaser: Russia’s total combat losses in personnel since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, have reached approximately 1,570,540, including 1,820 troops over the past day.
